CLE won 3 of 4 factors: shooting, ball security, getting to the line. Effective FG% 53.8 to 50.0.
Biggest swing: Cedi Osman makes 25-foot three point pullup jump shot (Q4 2:27), +17 points of CLE win probability.

Bench points: CLE 21, MEM 29. Points in the paint: 38–48. Second-chance points: 5–11.
